Biondo Investment Advisors Llc bought 2,740 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 133,839 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $22.65 million, up from 131,099 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Biondo Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $823.61B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.16% or $1.9 $162.32. About 35.66M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
